title: Account
description: Manage your account settings and security
profileDescription: Your identity details on the Roviq platform. Contact a platform administrator to request changes.
roviqIdDescription: Your unique Roviq ID is used to sign in and cannot be changed.
emailDescription: Used for security notifications and account recovery. Click the eye icon to reveal, or copy to clipboard.
scopeDescription: Determines which areas of Roviq you can sign in to.

language.title: Language
language.description: Save a language for this account across all Roviq portals. The topbar language selector changes only your current visit.
language.label: Preferred language
language.saveFailed: Could not save your language. Please try again.
language.loadFailed: Could not load your saved language.
language.impersonating: Language preferences cannot be changed while impersonating another account.

emailVerification.title: Email
emailVerification.description: The email address of your Roviq account.
emailVerification.whyVerify: Verify this address to show that it is yours. Until you do, an institute or reseller cannot give your account a new role by typing your email.
emailVerification.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to your email.
emailVerification.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {email}. It is valid for 10 minutes.

errors.codeShape: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
errors.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or send a new code.
errors.tooSoon: A code was sent a moment ago. Check your email, or wait a minute before asking for another.
errors.loadFailed: Your email status could not be loaded.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.limitReached: No more codes can be sent to this account today. Try again tomorrow.

displaySettings.title: Display settings
displaySettings.description: How Roviq shows forms to you. Saved to your account, so it follows you to any computer.

formHelp.title: Form help
formHelp.description: Every field that needs explaining has an ⓘ button. Choose whether forms also show a short hint under those labels.
formHelp.ICON_AND_HINTDescription: A one-sentence hint under labels where it helps. Easier while you are learning the forms.
formHelp.ICON_ONLYDescription: Hints are hidden, so forms are shorter. Tap ⓘ whenever you need an explanation.

displaySettings.saveFailed: Could not save your display settings. Your previous choice is still in use.
displaySettings.loadFailed: Could not load your saved settings. Forms use the default for now.
displaySettings.impersonating: You are viewing as another person, so their settings cannot be changed. Forms show the default.
